question: What is the refund policy for annual subscriptions?
ground_truth: Annual subscriptions are eligible for a full refund within 30 days of purchase.

question: How do I reset my password?
ground_truth: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page, enter your email, and follow the link sent to your inbox.

question: What are the system requirements for the desktop application?
ground_truth: The desktop app requires Windows 10 or macOS 12+, 8GB RAM, and 2GB free disk space.

question: How can I export my data?
ground_truth: Navigate to Settings > Data > Export, choose your format (CSV or JSON), and click Download.

question: What is the SLA for enterprise support?
ground_truth: Enterprise customers receive a 4-hour response SLA for critical issues and 24-hour for standard issues.

question: Can I integrate with Slack?
ground_truth: Yes, you can integrate with Slack via the integrations panel. Generate an API key and use the provided webhook URL.

question: How is data encrypted at rest?
ground_truth: All data is encrypted at rest using AES-256. Encryption keys are managed by AWS KMS.

question: What is the maximum file upload size?
ground_truth: The maximum file upload size is 100MB per file. Contact support for bulk upload options.

question: How do I add team members to my workspace?
ground_truth: Go to Workspace Settings > Members > Invite. Enter the email address and select a role (Admin, Editor, or Viewer).

question: Does the platform support SSO?
ground_truth: Yes, SSO is supported via SAML 2.0 and OIDC. Configure it in Settings > Security > Single Sign-On.

question: What happens when my free trial expires?
ground_truth: After trial expiry, your account moves to the free tier with limited features. Data is retained for 30 days.

question: Is there a mobile app available?
ground_truth: Yes, mobile apps are available for iOS (13+) and Android (10+) on their respective app stores.

question: How do I upgrade my plan?
ground_truth: Go to Billing > Plans and click Upgrade. Changes take effect immediately and you are charged the prorated difference.

question: What is the data retention policy?
ground_truth: Active account data is retained indefinitely. Deleted data is purged after 90 days. Audit logs are kept for 1 year.

question: Can I use the API without a paid plan?
ground_truth: The API is available on all plans. Free tier has a limit of 100 requests per day. Paid plans start at 10,000/day.

question: How do I contact customer support?
ground_truth: Contact support via the Help icon in-app, email support@company.com, or call 1-800-XXX-XXXX on business days.

question: What compliance certifications does the platform hold?
ground_truth: The platform is SOC 2 Type II certified, GDPR compliant, and HIPAA eligible for healthcare customers.

question: How do I set up two-factor authentication?
ground_truth: Go to Account Settings > Security > Two-Factor Authentication. Choose SMS or authenticator app and follow the setup wizard.

question: Can I downgrade my subscription?
ground_truth: Downgrades take effect at the end of the current billing cycle. You retain current-plan features until then.

question: What is the uptime SLA?
ground_truth: We guarantee 99.9% monthly uptime. Scheduled maintenance is excluded and communicated 48 hours in advance.

question: How do webhooks work?
ground_truth: Webhooks send HTTP POST requests to your endpoint when events occur. Configure them in Settings > Integrations > Webhooks.

question: Is offline access supported?
ground_truth: The desktop app supports offline mode for viewing cached documents. Edits sync automatically when reconnected.

question: How do I delete my account?
ground_truth: Go to Account Settings > Danger Zone > Delete Account. This is irreversible. Data is permanently deleted after 30 days.

question: What payment methods are accepted?
ground_truth: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, and PayPal. Annual plans also accept wire transfer and purchase orders.

question: How do I get an invoice for my payment?
ground_truth: Invoices are emailed automatically after each payment. You can also download them from Billing > Invoice History.
